results.name: FREE DOWNLOAD: Attractive African woman 236
results.description:
This is a 3d scanned model made with photogrammetry technique in our own custom built 3D scanner equipped with Canon 200D cameras.

This is a true human size and detailed model of a attractive young woman of African appearance dressed in a traditional dress. The model is captured in casual pose to be perfectly matching to variety of architectural visualization, background character, product visualization e.g. urban installations, city designs, outdoor design presentations, VR/AR content etc.

**Technical characteristics:**

* digital double 3d scan model
* decimated model (100k triangles)
* sufficiently clean
* PBR textures: Diffuse, Normal, Specular maps
* non-overlapping UV map

You may find some of our 3d models in free access on SketchFab https://sketchfab.com/deep3dstudio/collections/sample-basic-3d-models

**New 3d models every day!**

results.name: Skylar Breeze, a casual summer character scan
results.description: Skylar Breeze captures an easy, candid moment—a relaxed stance, hands on hips, half-turned smile, and the kind of posture that feels more real than posed. Dressed in a fitted light-blue summer dress with subtle texture detailing, white sneakers, and dark-framed glasses, she reads as contemporary and approachable without losing visual clarity in silhouette. The model balances realism with clean presentation, making it suitable for modern game environments, VR social spaces, crowd systems, or fashion/lifestyle visualization. Works especially well in daylight scenes and grounded urban or casual interior settings.

results.name: Roman Staute Woman
results.description:
Discover this 3D scan of a Roman statue of a woman from Casa di Olmo near Lake Como, Italy. The statue, dressed in classical drapery, showcases the elegance of Roman art and the rich history of the area.

Perfect for nanite use in the unreal engine.

Can be easily decimated in blender to 12k Tris without losing too much detail.

results.name: Chemise from Egypt
results.description:
Chemise, Egypt, radiocarbon dating: 1150 - 1260 with 95.4% of probability, linen, silk embroidery, Don Errera, 1900 - 1905. Musée du Cinquantenaire (Brussels, Belgium). Made with CpaturingReality.

This linen shirt or quamis was once one of the many layers of clothing of a wealthy Egyptian woman. Below was a wide pair of trousers over a dress. The outfit was completed by a coat and one or more wraps. Finely and regularly woven linen was chosen for this shirt. Previously embroidered, it was then cut according to a pattern and sewn. The extent given to the base and the pieces encrusted under the armpits make the shirt cool to wear and give freedom of movement to the body.

For more updates, please consider to follow me on Twitter at @GeoffreyMarchal.

results.name: Old Woman Figurine (C1981.19)

user.displayName: W.G. Hardy Museum, University of Alberta

results.description:
Terracotta group sculpture. Figure of an old woman wearing long dress with child standing at right arm and holding infant in left arm. The maker of this figure is unknown, but it can be dated to approximately 299-200 BCE and comes from the Campania area of Italy. The University of Alberta purchased this item.

More information can be found on the WG Hardy Museum Website using this link: https://search.museums.ualberta.ca/16-20159

Photos were taken with a Nikon Z5 with a 24-50mm lens. The model was created on Reality Scan using 273 images. Captured January 2026.
